_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: Cal.com OAuth is part of its Platform product and the token exchange path embeds the client id, which is unusual - it is not a fixed URL.
For a single account an API key is simpler and is what this connector offers first.
Self-hosted instances expose the same v2 API on their own host, so the base URL must be configurable.

personal_token.label: API key
notes: cal_live_ prefixes a live-mode key; cal_ alone is test mode. Connecting a test key against live data returns empty results rather than an error.

rate_limits.note: Documented starting point; higher on paid plans.

notes: Cal.com has an open issue about third-party OAuth for API v2, so the OAuth path here may not be generally available. The API key path is the one to rely on.
